scope: Aden siege only. Official Vanilla Game siege API is preferred; local logs are supported as a fallback.

counted: official siege API kill rows count as participant deaths
player-attributed non-teamkill deaths count as DAK kills
local-log fallback counts vanilla deaths inside the Aden siege window until the per-player siege death limit
excluded_from_dak_kills: same-clan teamkills when the official API marks teamkill=true
deaths without an identifiable player killer

target_strength.reliability: N / (N + 10), where N = DAK-counted kills + counted siege deaths

formula.season: monthly sum of Final for all sieges in the selected month
formula.average_score: average Final per played siege in the selected month
formula.design_note: Season and Avg are separate rankings: Season rewards monthly activity and consistency, Avg shows the best average result per played siege.
